name: Stade d'Olembé (Complexe Paul Biya)
description: The largest stadium in Cameroon with a capacity of 60,000 spectators, located in the northern Olembé neighborhood. It is designed as a massive modern sports complex that includes training pitches, commercial spaces, and multi-sport facilities.
bonASavoir: Situated about 13 kilometers north of the city center along the main highway. General entry outside match days is typically closed to the public unless a guided tour, official administration appointment, or community event is scheduled on site.The price bellow is the one you pay to have a place during a match
